Description: For 5s (+2s per rank), you speed up by 15% (+5% per rank) movement speed to catch up with your opponent. Your attack speed also increases by 10% (+10% per rank). CD: 23s

Through rigorous training, you have the stamina to leap 3 (+1 per rank) times consecutively, dealing 45 (+15 per rank) attack damage to foes you pass through. Each dash refreshes a 3.5s attack speed buff of 8% (+3% per rank). CD: 28s
During your travels, you accumulate up to 3 charges of rations from the surroundings. Each ration heals 80HP (+25 per rank) and 30 mana (+20 per rank). Ration accumulation rate: 25s (-7s per rank).
